Hull’s fairytale return to the Premier League has got off to a great start, but they’ll hope the international break hasn’t slowed their momentum ahead of the visit of unbeaten Everton.

## Match News and Current Form [...] Everton are one of five sides who start this round unbeaten in the Premier League (W2, D3), with belief building on Merseyside that European qualification is a realistic ambition. This matchday could give an early indication on whether that’s likely or not, as only twice before have the Toffees gone unbeaten in their first six games of a Premier League campaign, and both ended in a top-six finish.
